description: Utilities for converting and operating on ONNX, JIT, and torch types, including type mappings, type checks, and protocol definitions.

classes.name: TensorLike
classes.description: Protocol for objects that have a dtype property, compatible with torch.Tensor and TorchScriptTensor.

methods.name: is_torch_complex_dtype
methods.description: Checks if a torch.dtype is a complex type.

methods.name: from_complex_to_float
methods.description: Converts a complex torch.dtype to its corresponding float dtype.

methods.name: from_sym_value_to_torch_dtype
methods.description: Maps a symbolic value to its corresponding torch.dtype.

methods.name: is_optional_onnx_dtype_str
methods.description: Checks if a string represents an optional ONNX dtype.

methods.name: from_torch_dtype_to_onnx_dtype_str
methods.description: Returns ONNX dtype strings compatible with a given torch.dtype.

methods.name: from_python_type_to_onnx_attribute_type
methods.description: Maps Python types to ONNX attribute types, considering sequences.

methods.name: is_torch_symbolic_type
methods.description: Checks if a value is a symbolic torch type.

methods.name: from_torch_dtype_to_abbr
methods.description: Returns an abbreviation string for a torch.dtype.

methods.name: from_scalar_type_to_torch_dtype
methods.description: Maps a scalar Python type to a torch.dtype.
